housing: Most Angelenos rent, many in older apartment buildings, courtyard bungalows and duplexes; buildings built on or before October 1, 1978 are often covered by the city's Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

localRules.text: Owners of units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (generally built on or before October 1, 1978) must register them with the Los Angeles Housing Department every year and report the rent each tenant pays.

tenantHelp.name: Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD)
tenantHelp.what: city housing department; rent stabilization and tenant rights

climate: Test the air conditioning or fans and check windows and screens; also photograph any cracks in walls, since the city sits in an earthquake zone.
fact: Whether your Los Angeles apartment is under rent stabilization mostly depends on when the building was built, so check its status with LAHD.
